lede: The day's clearest signal came from a single bet. A Polymarket contract on whether the Tesla Roadster will reach 60 mph in under a second settled at about 99.95 percent yes on more than $5 million in volume, while the car itself drew 1,308 points on Hacker News. The other large numbers were about spectacle rather than certainty: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer passed 31.3 million views on YouTube, and the most-read Wikipedia article was the GBU-43/B MOAB, the munition nicknamed the Mother of All Bombs, at 453,110 views.

throughlines.title: Will the Tesla Roadster's 0-60 time be less than 1 second?
throughlines.gist: A prediction market and a Hacker News thread landed on the same car the same day, one pricing the sub-one-second claim at near certainty, the other arguing over whether the spec is real.

throughlines.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
throughlines.gist: Rockstar's launch trailer crossed YouTube and Steam at once, a reminder that one trailer can move both a video platform and a storefront well before the game ships.

throughlines.title: FLUX 3 Image Klein
throughlines.gist: Black Forest Labs' new FLUX 3 image model surfaced on Hacker News and Hugging Face together, with downloads already in the tens of thousands, a sign an open image-generation release still pulls developers and users in the same beat.
